# Lesson Planet

> Lesson Planet is a comprehensive educational resource platform offering 2.5M+ standards-aligned lesson plans, worksheets, and videos for K-12 teachers.

Founded by Jim Hurley, Lesson Planet serves both educators and homeschooling parents with curated, CCSS and NGSS-aligned instructional materials. The platform provides tools for lesson planning, curriculum management, and resource discovery across all major subject areas.

## Key Topics

- Lesson Planning
- Standards-Aligned Resources
- Common Core State Standards (CCSS)
- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- Teacher Tools
- Curriculum Management
- Educational Resources
- Worksheets & Lesson Plans
- OER Library
- Resource Curation
- Classroom Materials
- Standards-Based Learning
- Curriculum Design
- K-12 Education
- Collection Builder

## Getting Started

- [Lesson Plans & Worksheets for School Teachers | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com): Homepage showcasing 2.5M lesson plans, worksheets, videos with CCSS/NGSS alignment
- [Lesson Planet - Create Your Account](https://lessonplanet.com/subscription/new): Account creation and subscription signup page for Lesson Planet membership
- [Pricing Content | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/pricing): Subscription pricing and membership tier options with Learning Explorer

## Core Resources

- [Lesson Plans & Worksheets for Teachers | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/lesson-plans): Main lesson plans browsing page organized by K-12 grade and subject
- [Language Arts Lesson Plans & Worksheets | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/lesson-plans/language-arts): Language arts resources aligned to Common Core literacy standards
- [Health Lesson Plans & Worksheets | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/lesson-plans/health): Health and wellness lesson plans covering nutrition, fitness, safety

## Platform Editions

- [Educator Edition | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/educator-edition): Teacher-focused edition with standards-aligned lesson planning tools
- [Parent Edition | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/parent-edition): Homeschooling resources and lesson planning tools for parents

## Planning & Reference Tools

- [March Curriculum Calendar - Lesson Plan Ideas by Date | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/calendar): Curriculum calendar with daily teaching ideas tied to historical events
- [Lesson Planning Articles | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/articles): Teacher articles on lesson planning, strategies, and classroom management

## Support & Information

- [Frequently Asked Questions | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/faq): FAQs covering product features, getting started, and resource curation
- [Contact Us | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/contact-us): Contact information for Lesson Planet offices in Santa Barbara and Woburn
- [About | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/about): Company overview, mission, and history founded by Jim Hurley
- [Member Testimonial | Lesson Planet](https://lessonplanet.com/us/testimonials): Archive of written and video testimonials from Lesson Planet members

## Sample Lessons & Units

- [Amazing Birds Unit Plan for Kindergarten - 4th Grade | Lesson Planet](https://www.lessonplanet.com/teachers/amazing-birds-k-4th): K-4th grade unit plan on bird behavior from Cornell Lab of Ornithology
- [How to Write a Haiku Activity for 3rd - 8th Grade | Lesson Planet](https://www.lessonplanet.com/teachers/how-to-write-a-haiku): 3rd-8th grade poetry activity teaching haiku composition and structure
- [Rosa Parks: Mini Biography Instructional Video for 8th - 12th Grade | Lesson Planet](https://www.lessonplanet.com/teachers/rosa-parks-mini-biography): 8th-12th grade video on Rosa Parks and Montgomery Bus Boycott
- [Recursive Formulas: Fibonacci Sequence Interactive for 11th - Higher Ed | Lesson Planet](https://www.lessonplanet.com/teachers/recursive-formulas-fibonacci-sequence): 11th grade+ interactive lesson on Fibonacci sequence and recursion
